value.value: Oxygenated MWNT groups coordinate Cd precursor and seed in situ CdTe growth after Te solution injection. Nanotubes function as sterically bulky π-conjugated ligands and growth terminators.

value.value: Substoichiometric TDPA leaves some Cd available for surface coordination, especially through carboxylic acid/alcohol groups. No ligand-binding constant, available-site density or stoichiometric competition measurement is reported.

value.value: A nanotube limits access to one crystal face; incoming monomer preferentially reaches the free end, producing pseudo-one-dimensional or anisotropic growth. This is a steric/diffusion interpretation, not a measured monomer-flux map.

value.value: Local group density, site geometry and spatial separation of groups on one tube or adjacent tubes can alter growth and the broad crystal size/shape range.

value.value: Greater tip coverage is linked to curvature-induced reactivity and abundant oxygenated groups after cap opening/outer-wall etching. Aggressive oxidation also creates active sidewall sites.

value.value: Bulky nanotubes cap limited surface regions, leaving incomplete passivation and possible surface oxidation during prolonged air exposure. Source TeO3 wording is retained; exposure kinetics and oxide identity are not independently resolved.

value.value: Conventional oxidation of SWNTs has difficulty creating enough groups for dense QD growth without compromising tube structure/electronic integrity. This is qualitative extension context, not a fully specified current SWNT synthesis.

value.value: Future directions include charge transport through junctions, crystal growth across aligned nanotubes and thin composite films. Photovoltaic/electronic benefits remain proposed; no device efficiency, mobility or current–voltage measurement appears here.

quality.review_scope: All nine main pages and the matched one-page SI text-read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Nanotube pretreatment, CdTe growth, distinct bound/free/comparison populations, structural/optical analyses and author mechanisms retain their own evidence scopes. Missing reagent doses, Te stock form/concentration, final drying conditions and printed EDS unit discrepancy remain explicit. Cited external works not independently inspected.
missing_fields: No chemical masses, Cd:Te ratio, exact TDPA ratio, Te/TOP stock concentration or injection volume, isolated yield or raw spectral arrays are supplied.
No measured atom coordinates, unit-cell refinement, quantitative phase fraction, sample-specific complete particle distribution, electronic transport or photovoltaic device data are supplied.
Main procedures are partial literature descriptions; referenced external protocols do not fill unreported conditions.
